user.title: Add a Tuya IR hub
user.description: Choose how to connect your local IR gateway. Reuse only IR Studio's own saved Tuya / Smart Life QR session, sign in via QR, or enter local credentials manually.

cloud.title: Tuya / Smart Life account
cloud.description: In the Smart Life or Tuya app, open Settings → Account & Security and find your User Code. Enter it to request a login QR code.

scan.title: Complete sign-in
scan.description: Open the Smart Life or Tuya app, scan the QR code, then submit this form to complete authorization.

choose_device.title: Choose the IR device and gateway
choose_device.description: Choose the IR device and its parent gateway. An already configured gateway can appear in the separate parent list. QR is used to set up the gateway only, not to import remote buttons.

search.title: Find the gateway on your LAN
search.description: {device_name}IR Studio will scan the local network for the parent gateway's IP address. If discovery fails, enter the address manually on the next step.

native_hub.title: Confirm the local IR hub
native_hub.description: Check the detected host and protocol. The Local Key is stored in Home Assistant; IR Studio communicates with the hub over your LAN.

data.device_id: Device ID (for a child device, use the parent gateway ID)

abort.already_configured: This Tuya IR gateway is already configured.
abort.no_devices: No suitable Tuya devices with a Local Key were found.

error.login_error: Tuya / Smart Life sign-in failed or was not completed. Request a new QR code and try again.
error.needs_hub: This device is connected through a gateway. Select its parent gateway.
error.does_not_need_hub: This device can be connected directly. Do not select a parent gateway.
error.invalid_device: The selected Tuya device is no longer available.
error.invalid_hub: The selected parent gateway is not valid.
error.missing_node_id: The child device has no node_id or uuid.
error.missing_local_key: No Local Key was returned for this device or gateway.
error.device_not_found: Automatic LAN discovery did not find the gateway. Enter its local IP address.
error.invalid_credentials: Enter an IP address, Device ID and Local Key.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the local Tuya IR gateway. Check the IP, Device ID, Local Key, child device ID and protocol.

options.cloud: Tuya / Smart Life — use IR Studio's saved QR session or sign in with QR
options.manual: Manual local setup — IP, Device ID and Local Key
options.cloud_fresh_login: Tuya / Smart Life — start a fresh QR login

create_remote.title: Add a virtual IR remote
create_remote.description: A remote device and entity will be created in Home Assistant. The selected IR transmitter will learn and send commands; buttons are added only after learning.

add_command.title: Learn a button
add_command.description: Choose a command label from the library or enter a custom one (for example Power, Mute or VOL +). Then point the original remote at the IR hub and press the button.

rename_remote.title: Rename remote
rename_remote.description: Changing the visible name does not change the learned signal namespace or Home Assistant entity IDs.

remove_command.title: Remove button
remove_command.description: Delete the selected button from the virtual remote? Physical-driver IR storage is not deleted.

remove_remote.title: Delete remote {name}
remove_remote.description: This removes its Home Assistant virtual remote and buttons. Physical hub and separately stored driver signals remain untouched.

interface.title: Advanced editor
interface.description: For most users, Home Assistant's Configure wizard is sufficient. The optional legacy editor adds a sidebar item.

data.show_panel: Show advanced IR Studio panel in sidebar

rename_command.title: Rename button
rename_command.description: The visible label changes; the stored IR signal does not.

change_icon.title: Remote icon
change_icon.description: Choose an icon from Home Assistant's visual MDI picker. Signals remain unchanged.

test_button.title: Test button
test_button.description: On confirmation, send the IR command ONCE. A successful call does not prove the appliance received it.

relearn_button.title: Relearn button
relearn_button.description: Learn a replacement signal. The button name, HA unique ID and IR command namespace remain unchanged.

progress.learn: Waiting for the original remote's IR signal

abort.not_ready: IR Studio is not ready. Check the integration status.
abort.no_profiles: No remote has been created yet.

error.learn_failed: Learning failed. Check Home Assistant logs and try again.
error.busy: An IR learning job is still running.
error.send_failed: IR transmission failed. Check gateway and logs.
